How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NEHU Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NEHU Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NEHU Junior Research Fellow position is 09-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class M.Sc/M.Tech in Food Engineering and Technology/ Food Technology/Biotechnology/Chemical Engineering/ Agriculture Process Engineering/Bioprocess Engineering and its allied subjects.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 35,000 plus HRA.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the NEHU Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your bio-data and required documents to the official email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the North-Eastern Hill University (NEHU) located?
faq.answer: North-Eastern Hill University (NEHU) is located in Tura, Meghalaya, with the pincode 794002.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is TC/NEHU/ABMFT/DBT-NER/2021.

faq.question: Q10. When will the personal interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The personal interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to be conducted on 14-08-2026.
